verdict.rationale: Fastmail is an email product, so handling other customer channels in the same inbox is a fair question for it. The evidence pack covers only email (JMAP, filters, aliases, templates, masked email), calendar and contacts. Nothing shows SMS, WhatsApp, social or live-chat channels inside the Fastmail inbox.

support.subject: As a team-lead, the same inbox also handles adjacent customer channels — SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live chat — beside email
